chunks: The qunut is in the first rak'ah before the ruku'.
From him, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Abi Basir, who said:

key_terms.أَبِي بَصِيرٍ: the narrator Abu Basir in the sanad
key_terms.القُنُوتُ: the supplicatory standing performed during salat
key_terms.الْأُولَىٰ: the first of two or more units

ai.seo_question: Where is the qunut performed in the first rak'ah of Salat al-Jumu'ah?
ai.summary: This report concerns the placement of qunut in the prayer, specifically indicating that it is performed in the first rak'ah before the ruku'. It reflects a jurisprudential ruling related to the manner of performing salat, within the context of Salat al-Jumu'ah.
